description: Four clock outputs locked to the Tracker's beat, each divided or multiplied, shifted and swung on its own

params.text: Sets the rate of that clock against the track's beat: one pulse a beat in the middle, up to 96 pulses a beat turned right and one pulse every 96 beats turned left
Shifts that clock through its own cycle, a whole cycle across the travel
Sets how much of that clock's cycle the pulse is high, none of it fully left and all of it fully right
Swings that clock by moving the halfway point of the beat, one way delaying every other pulse and the other way bringing it forward; centred there is no swing

outputs.text: That clock, 10V while its pulse is high and 0V the rest of the time

notes: nothing comes out of this until a Tracker module is somewhere in the patch; the two are joined through the plugin rather than by a cable, so where it goes in the rack does not matter.
all four outputs rest at 0V while the track is stopped; they only run while the Tracker is playing.
menu: Mode: Fixed, Loop — sets whether a divided clock restarts when a pattern loops or carries straight on through it; the maker marks Loop as not implemented
